model.title: Weather Research and Forecasting Innovation Reauthorization Act of 2026
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would authorize funding and support for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's weather research programs, with the aim of improving weather forecasting and prediction capabilities. It would also seek to expand opportunities for private companies to provide weather data and related services.
